parts.title: Dead Things Become Your Food?! The Secret Life Of A Compost Bin | TheOneApp, Explored EP10
parts.description:
Be a tiny bit of nutrient in a dead grasshopper: decomposers break it down, you go into the soil and a school compost bin, feed a chye sim plant, get eaten by a grasshopper, and one day go back to the soil. Then Heart explains decomposers and detritivores from the Primary 6 textbook, how composting and recycling mean less ash at Pulau Semakau, food security, and how to make composting a habit.
